item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera learns in class that breathing and respiration are different processes. Which statement is correct?

options.A: Breathing and respiration are two names for exactly the same process.
options.B: Breathing is a physical process of taking in and giving out air, while respiration is a chemical process that releases energy inside the body.
options.C: Respiration is a physical process because no new substance is formed in the body.
options.D: Respiration produces oxygen, which breathing then carries out of the body.
